highlights: 初始开源版本：在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧标签页打开、编辑和保存 Word、Excel、PPT 文件，对话里的 AI 能在编辑器里实时新建和修改文档。
自带 PPT 蓝色品牌风格和 Word 公文版式，装好就能用；文档引擎在第一次打开文档时自动下载。
highlightsEn: First open-source release: open, edit and save Word, Excel and PPT files in a tab on the right of DeepSeek Harness, and the AI in the chat creates and edits documents live in the editor.
Comes with the PPT Blue Brand style and the Word official-document layout, ready to use after install; the document engine downloads automatically the first time you open a document.
